decisions.decision: The town should not install $281,000 worth of EV charging stations; instead install a couple of stations covering 4 spots, with a minimum of two, expandable later.
decisions.quote: the town should not install $281,000 worth of electric vehicle (ev) charging stations, but rather a couple of charging stations that cover 4 spots

decisions.decision: The team agreed to further explore the feasibility of solar panels and EV charging stations.

decisions.decision: Michael-Ray Jeffreys to contact Chris Ruth for more details on hazardous materials in Town Hall and Ritter building.

decisions.decision: Committee to include alternates (like EV chargers, Meeting House basement slab, solar panels) in the bid package for potential future implementation.
